{{Quote|Will you light the sky on fire? Will you light the sky like you did the night before?|The vocalist, singing "Light the Sky on Fire"|<ref name="SWHS" />}}
A [[Gender/Legends|male]] '''singer''' was the lead vocalist of an all-[[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Unidentified Human band|band]] in the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]], that singer's band was popular on [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]], the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiees]].<ref name="SWHS" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The Human singer appeared in ''[[The Star Wars Holiday Special]]'', a TV movie set in the ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]] that aired in [[1978]]. The band singer was played by [[Marty Balin]], the lead vocalist of the real-life band [[Jefferson Starship]], who portrayed a fictional band in the TV special.<ref name="SWHS" />
